taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-01 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1056.4 | 23.97 | 23.97
2 | 1090.4 | 1.46 | 25.43
3 | 2606.8 | 3.17 | 28.60
4 | 3560.6 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as A-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-01
Curve type: A-type
Aquifer depth: 25.43 – 28.60 m (Layer 3, weathered/fractured zone overlying resistive basement)
Recommendation: Target drilling through the 25.43–28.60 m interval, as this moderately resistive layer likely represents a weathered/fractured basement aquifer; confirm with cuttings and proceed cautiously once the high-resistivity basement (Layer 4) is encountered below 28.60 m, as further yield is unlikely in the compact bedrock.
